# @canopy/protocol

The canopy.v1 wire protocol: message types, the EJSON-lite codec and error codes.

Every other package speaks it; you need it directly to decode EJSON or to check error codes without the client.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/protocol
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { CanopyError, ErrorCode, parse, stringify } from "@canopy/protocol"

const value = parse('{"createdAt":{"$date":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}') // createdAt is a Date
const text = stringify(value) // EJSON text again
const refusal = new CanopyError(ErrorCode.Forbidden, "no policy grants this operation")
```
